scenes.focus: exactly three separate aged wax-sealed letters arranged in a loose triangle on an old oak detective desk, with a cup of long-cold tea between them
scenes.camera: medium-close high three-quarter view of all three sealed envelopes on the single desktop, no people present
scenes.location: a modest private detective office in rainy industrial Birmingham in the 1920s
required: exactly three distinct closed wax-sealed paper envelopes spread apart across the table
one decorated porcelain teacup on its saucer next to the envelopes
weathered railway sketches and ordinary papers partly beneath the envelopes
scenes.background: brass desk lamp, dark wooden surfaces, vintage leather document case, window showing wet brick factories and smoky chimneys
scenes.light: warm amber desk lamp on paper and oak with cold blue-grey daylight through rain-streaked glass
scenes.npc: an empty office with no character faces and no hands
scenes.knowledgeBoundary: The three letters offer alternative tactics but do not establish any chosen path, confirmed evidence, deal or safety guarantee
avoid: readable names, business names, dates, exact numbers or signatures on the envelopes
a chosen or completed investigation outcome
new evidence asserted as proven or witnesses already protected
